content:
maria_cs: FYI Bamboo Inc onboarding update. Seen recurring p95 regressions after their daily ingestion window (~11:30am PST). Renewal in ~6 weeks and procurement asked for a clear cost reduction play without degrading production quality. Need quick, low-risk options: quantize, route non-critical workloads, and a canary plan.

sanjay_sre: Can we get exact model + region? rough seq len profile? that'll shape whether caching or quant helps more.

maria_cs: They're on `redwood/rdx-large-13B` fp16 in us-west, avg seq ~100, p95 ~600 tokens, spikes when long transcripts come in (~1k tokens). Sample log:```
2026-03-20T15:01:00 req=zzz111 model=rdx-large-13B p95=1.4s tokens=980 cost=$0.12
2026-03-20T15:01:05 req=zzz112 model=rdx-large-13B p95=1.55s tokens=1022 cost=$0.14
```

olivia_se: For large models the win from int8/native 4-bit differs. Suggest a two-track approach: A) per-channel int8 calibration for rdx-large to keep quality tight, B) spin up a quantized rdx-medium-6B-ptq as a low-priority target for async jobs. Also enable prefix caching for the first 128 tokens on chat flows.

tom_finance: Procurement target: 25%+ reduction in per-token unit cost or a predictable discount in committed usage. Quality loss must be negligible.

emma_product: Proposed canary: 5% traffic -> rdx-large-int8 (calibrated), 10% -> rdx-medium-6B-quant for background summarization, 85% baseline. Metric windows 72h. Tracking: latency p50/p95, cost per request, and semantic_consistency score (cosine sim on embeddings) and hallucination_rate. Gate to ramp if: cost_reduction >=25% and semantic_drop <=0.75%.

sanjay_sre: Infra checklist: 1) run QProf calibration with their top-1000 tokens to produce int8 artifact. 2) perf test at seq=1024 with batch sizes 1/2/4. 3) routing rule sample: ```if request.meta.priority == 'background' then route: rdx-medium-6B-quant else baseline``` with a fallback to baseline on 500ms timeout. 4) add content_hash check to detect tokenization drift.

deploybot: Canary scheduled slot -> 1961003600. Reminder: create canary eval set under Bamboo/canary-v2.

olivia_se: I'll assemble a 150-prompt canary set focused on their top intents and the long-transcript cases. Also recommend a syntactic-preservation test to catch truncation/regression.

maria_cs: Action list: @olivia_se produce canary prompts by EOD tomorrow, @sanjay_sre build calibrated int8 artifact and run perf tests, @emma_product wire dashboards/alerts and prepare an executive one-pager for procurement with rollback steps.

tom_finance: We'll share procurement contacts and can review the one-pager. Also request that cost modeling include worst-case (no batching) and best-case (dynamic batching up to 8).

emma_product: Alerts: trigger if semantic_consistency drops >0.7% OR hallucination_rate increases by 0.5% OR latency_p95 increases >20%. Also add automatic rollback if content_hash mismatch rate >0.3%.

sanjay_sre: Note on quant: if per-channel int8 still shows quality drift, we fall back to mixed-precision (fp16 for attention layers) and route long-context requests to baseline. Will include these in the rollback plan.

maria_cs: Perfect. I'll schedule a results review 3 days after slot (Wed 11am PST) and include Bamboo leadership. Keeping this thread as the source of truth. :white_check_mark:

tom_finance: Thanks all. Appreciate the measured plan.
